content.intro: Learn saving, updating, and deleting records through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines saving, updating, and deleting records as part of django models and database fundamentals. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: Worked example: Saving, Updating, and Deleting Records
content_blocks.code:
from django.db.models import Count

# Example QuerySet; assumes Book has a category relation.
Book.objects.values("category__name").annotate(total=Count("id")).order_by("category__name")
content_blocks.expected_output: The QuerySet groups records by related category name and annotates a count.
